subject: Commercial cadence: acceptance windows, tranche pricing, and go/no-go gating
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acmecorp.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lydia Park <lydia.park@acmecorp.com>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: initial evaluation scope and timelines

Vanessa / Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo on Thursday. Acme leadership wants clarity on how we would structure a short evaluation (4–6 weeks) that ties clear acceptance criteria to committed capacity and a ramped pricing curve. Two things to confirm before we pull legal in:

1) Can Redwood put milestone-based pricing in writing (tranches tied to MAP checkpoints)?
2) What are the acceptance windows — e.g., how long after a checkpoint do we have to raise issues before we fail a checkpoint?

We need something our procurement team can show the CFO this week.

—Jordan
Procurement, Acme Corp
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lydia Park <lydia.park@acmecorp.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: initial evaluation scope and timelines

Jordan — appreciate the clarity. High level answer: yes, we can structure tranche pricing tied to MAP checkpoints and define a short acceptance window. Attached is a focused proposal (redwood_pricing_ladder_v3.pdf) and a MAP checkpoint matrix (map_checkpoint_matrix.xlsx) that lays out:

• Week 0: Provisioning & integration verification (no charge; setup support included)
• Week 1–2: Pilot throughput validation — discounted eval rate at 50% list for first 100k tokens
• Week 3–4: Feature verification & quality gates — move to 75% list for next tranche if quality gates met
• Week 5–6: Ramp to committed baseline — final tranche price at 90% list with committed token floors

Acceptance windows: 7 calendar days after each checkpoint for either party to surface regressions tied to predefined evaluation prompts. If a checkpoint fails, we agree on a remediation plan and a single 7-day extension; after that, either side can trigger the go/no-go review.

Next steps: If this aligns with Acme's expectations, Marissa and I will update the commercial terms and circulate a short SOW + one-page MAP for procurement.

—Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Acme MAP tranche pricing — signoff path and asks

Team — threading you for a quick internal alignment before I send the formal version to Acme. Jordan asked for tranche pricing tied to MAP checkpoints plus an explicit 7-day acceptance window. I attached the working matrix. Specific asks:

- Marissa: please confirm discount levels per tranche (we proposed 50%/75%/90% list across the eval ramp). Are these OK to move to legal?
- Ben: need confirmation that Dedicated pool provisioning for the pilot (50k–100k tokens) can be guaranteed within 5 business days of SOW sign. Any infra caveats?
- Priyom: are there compliance artifacts (short SOC note / data handling bullet points) we should include in the one-page MAP to speed procurement?

Proposed timeline: I want to lock the MAP and SOW by Friday, 7 May so procurement can review next week.

Thanks — Vanessa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Acme MAP tranche pricing — signoff path and asks

Vanessa — I reviewed the numbers. 50/75/90 is aggressive but defensible given the short eval and clear checkpoints. A couple of internal clarifications before we send:

• Make the 50% tranche capped at 100k tokens total for the pilot (avoid open-ended exposure).
• Add an explicit clause that runway tokens don't auto-convert to committed capacity unless both parties sign the final SOW.
• For incentives: propose a 10% additional credit on the final tranche if customer signs a 12-month Reserved Capacity within 30 days of acceptance. That gives the CFO a clear incentive and preserves our economics.

Ben — can you confirm capacity SLA for the pilot? If we can guarantee provisioning <=5 business days we should be good to move forward.

—Marissa
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Acme MAP tranche pricing — signoff path and asks

Confirming infra: We can provision a dedicated pilot pool (NVLink-compatible) within 3 business days of an approved SOW and billing cleared. Pilot cap at 100k tokens is fine. Caveats: if sequence-length distribution is heavy (long prompts) we may need to drop throughput SLOs by ~10% during peak times — I'll note that in the SOW.

Priyom: as Vanessa suggested, include a short compliance summary (SOC 2 scope, retention/ingestion bullets) — a one-page attachment will remove friction with procurement.

—Ben
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acmecorp.com>, Lydia Park <lydia.park@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Final: commercial cadence & MAP — proposal attached

Jordan / Lydia — thanks for the patience. Attached is our updated one-page MAP and SOW (redwood_pricing_ladder_v3.pdf, map_checkpoint_matrix.xlsx) reflecting the internal clarifications we discussed:

• Tranches: Pilot (50% list, capped at 100k tokens) → Feature validation (75% list) → Commit baseline (90% list)
• Acceptance window: 7 calendar days after checkpoint; single 7-day remediation allowed
• Incentive: 10% credit on final tranche if Acme signs a 12-month Reserved Capacity within 30 days of acceptance
• Infra: Dedicated pilot pool provisioned within 3 business days after SOW and billing clearance (note on long-sequence SLO variance included)

Please review the attached SOW and MAP. If this reflects Acme's needs, confirm by replying with APPROVE and we will route a short SOW + DocuSign for signatures.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_ladder_v3.pdf (proposal), map_checkpoint_matrix.xlsx (checkpoint matrix)

Best —
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
